owner_decisions.answer: Own child in Adventure for rally-style and lightweight ADV models (690 Rally, 450 Rally Replica, Ténéré World Raid), separate from big-bore touring ADVs. Pure race news can also carry Racing (multi-label).

Adventure keeps an 'ADV Events & Competitions' child: GS Trophy, Dakar and rally-raid, brand challenges, round-the-world/record rides. Event reports and previews are already forms, so this child is about the subject.
No child. The ride-report form already lets readers find trip and destination stories.
No child for ADV gear, ADV customs or off-road modern classics; they keep Adventure and also get Gear/Custom/Classic.
Added after the first Jev test, which left the largest bike group (GS, Multistrada, 1390, Tiger, Pan America) without a child.

notes: First draft (model-proposed) let the rally child catch Dakar news (0.61) and a Himalayas travel blog (0.50), and the events child catch a 450 Rally Replica gallery (0.52). Rewording both as 'mainly about a specific model' vs 'mainly about an event' cleared all three. The Voge DS9 (middleweight) lands in both bike children, which is acceptable. The R 12 G/S review lands in Adventure Touring and should also carry Classic.
